listings.name: Bidniz Technologies
listings.current_description: Bidniz Technologies is an IT consulting firm in Waterkloof Glen offering cloud solutions, managed IT services and cyber security, along with contract management and business intelligence tools for clients in legal, financial services, manufacturing and healthcare.

listings.name: Biz Evolution
listings.current_description: Biz Evolution is an accounting and tax firm in Shere offering bookkeeping, payroll, VAT and company registrations, and SARS dispute support, staffed by SAIPA-registered and SAIT- and CIBA-affiliated professionals with over 35 years of combined experience.

listings.name: Blast-it Vapour Blasting
listings.current_description: Blast-it Vapour Blasting uses a water-and-abrasive vapour blasting technique to clean, strip rust from, and restore metal surfaces such as engine parts, tools, and automotive components, positioning itself as an eco-friendly alternative to replacing damaged parts.

listings.name: Bluline Chartered Business Accountants
listings.current_description: Bluline Chartered Business Accountants, established in 2021 and based in Boardwalk Office Park, Faerie Glen, provides accounting, tax, secretarial, and financial statement services with remote delivery to clients including doctors, lawyers, and mining and transport companies.

listings.name: Bosch Car Service Centre Pretoria
listings.current_description: Bosch Car Service Centre Pretoria is an RMI-approved, Bosch-certified vehicle workshop in Gezina, Pretoria, offering vehicle servicing, cambelt replacement, brake and clutch repairs, diagnostics, auto electrical work, suspension, and air conditioning services using genuine Bosch parts.

listings.name: Botes Attorneys
listings.current_description: Trading as Erik Botes Inc. - Attorneys at Law, this Rietondale-based firm handles Road Accident Fund claims, contested divorces, antenuptial contracts, property transfers, contract drafting and notarial work, labour law, criminal law and medical negligence claims.

listings.name: BR Rekenmeesters
listings.current_description: BR Rekenmeesters is a full-service accounting firm at 44 Hoogenhout Street in Sinoville, Pretoria, with over 30 years' experience providing tax registration, tax returns, payroll and financial advisory services, and recognised as a SAIPA training centre.

listings.name: BRAND CIRCLE
listings.current_description: Brand Circle is a marketing and branding consultancy based in Montana Park, Pretoria, founded in 2013, offering digital marketing, website development, social media, SEO, branding and advertising campaign services to small and medium-sized businesses across Africa.

listings.name: Bright Packaging & Raw Materials - Centurion
listings.current_description: Bright Packaging & Raw Materials is a Centurion-based supplier of packaging (bottles, jars, pouches, closures), raw materials (oils, butters, waxes, preservatives, fragrances), and equipment for entrepreneurs and small businesses making personal care, household, and specialty products.

listings.name: BusinessNeeds Online
listings.current_description: BusinessNeeds Online is a Pretoria-based business consultancy offering accounting and bookkeeping, SARS tax and VAT services, payroll and UIF/PAYE processing, and CIPC company registration and compliance services, along with trademark and import/export licence applications.

listings.name: Businesss Engineering
listings.current_description: Business Engineering & Collaboration (be.co.za) is a Gauteng-based company that develops custom software, SaaS platforms and data-processing solutions for infrastructure owners, operators, developers and consultants, covering areas such as electricity, water and waste management.

listings.name: Bvumbi Ready Mix Akasia
listings.current_description: Bvumbi Ready Mix is a black-owned, youth-led ready-mix concrete supplier founded in 2019, producing concrete grades from 10 MPa to 60 MPa plus concrete pumping services, with this branch serving the Akasia and Pretoria North area.

listings.name: C.A & W Services CC
listings.current_description: C.A & W Services CC is an Eldoraigne-based IT services company with over 30 years of experience, offering software development (.NET, Angular, SQL Server), IT infrastructure support and consulting across Windows, Linux and Docker environments.

listings.name: Carbon Press
listings.current_description: Carbon Press is a Pretoria printing company established in 2004, specializing in self-carbonized NCR books such as quotation, delivery note, invoice and receipt books, as well as business cards, calendars, letterheads, flyers, die cutting and laminating.

listings.name: Castor King Products
listings.current_description: Castor King Products in Zandfontein, Pretoria, trades under Forklift & Mining Spares, supplying new and used forklift spares, forklift sales, rentals, repairs and maintenance from a workshop with used units available for breaking down into parts.

listings.name: Centurion Canvas
listings.current_description: Centurion Canvas is a custom canvas manufacturer in Hennopspark, Centurion, producing outdoor blinds, canvas canopies, caravan and trailer covers, bags and seat covers, hunting and lodge gear, and luxury tents, made locally in their Centurion workshop.

listings.name: Centurion Ice Cream & Sweets
listings.current_description: Centurion Ice Cream & Sweets is a factory ice-cream and sweets shop on the corner of Galway and Kilkenny Streets in Bronberrik, retailing and wholesaling ice cream and also supplying restaurants and caterers, trading since 1995.

listings.name: Chalwil Engineering cc
listings.current_description: Chalwil Engineering cc is an engineering and manufacturing company in Rosslyn, Pretoria, specialising in gear rebuilding, prop-shaft refurbishing, cylinder head work, general machining (milling, turning and wire cutting), and the manufacture of custom tools and parts.

listings.name: Chicken factory shop Pretoria-online business
listings.current_description: Chicken Factory Shop Pretoria CC is a registered close corporation on Van Der Hoff Road, Booysens, Pretoria, listed in business directories as an online chicken retail business; further detail on its product range was not found.

listings.name: Chicken Licken
listings.current_description: Chicken Licken outlet at Shop 94, Jubilee Mall, corner of Jubilee and Harry Gwala Roads, Hammanskraal, serving the chain's fried chicken and fast food menu; as a mall-based store it operates within Jubilee Mall's trading hours.

listings.name: Clickwise Agency
listings.current_description: Clickwise Agency is a digital marketing agency based in Menlyn Corporate Park, Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, offering social media marketing, SEO and Google Ads management, website design, marketing strategy and consulting, and CRM/WhatsApp API integration services.

listings.name: CM Civils
listings.current_description: CM Civils is a 100% black-owned, multi-disciplinary construction and engineering group based in Pretoria, specialising in roads and stormwater drainage, paving construction, tendering and quantity surveying, and property development across industrial, commercial, retail, and residential sectors.

listings.name: Collaborit Asset Management Engineering
listings.current_description: Collaborit Asset Management Engineering, founded in 2004 and headquartered in South Africa, provides SAP EAM implementation, reliability engineering and predictive maintenance for asset-intensive industries such as mining, energy and manufacturing, with offices in over 20 countries.

listings.name: Context Africa
listings.current_description: Context Africa is a market research and insights consultancy based in Villieria, Pretoria, specialising in African markets. It conducts qualitative research such as interviews and focus groups, and evaluates corporate social investment (CSI) impact for clients.

listings.name: Copfin - Kyocera Office Document Solutions
listings.current_description: Copfin is an authorised Kyocera reseller based in Lynnwood Glen, Pretoria, selling and renting printers and multifunction office devices, and providing repair and maintenance services for multiple printer brands as well as toner and ink supply.

listings.name: Cornerstone Guest Lodge
listings.current_description: Cornerstone Guest Lodge is a guesthouse in Lynnwood Ridge, Pretoria, offering individually decorated, air-conditioned rooms with en-suite bathrooms and kitchenettes, along with two swimming pools, braai facilities, a tennis court, a lounge area, and full-day security.

listings.name: Cosmo Pools (Pty) Ltd.
listings.current_description: Cosmo Pools manufactures and installs fibreglass swimming pools as well as concrete pools, and also offers pool relining and renovation, with fibreglass pool installs typically completed in 5-7 days and backed by a 10-year structural guarantee.

listings.name: Cratos Life (PTY) LTD - Midlands
listings.current_description: Cratos Life (PTY) LTD is a juristic representative of Discovery Life and authorised financial services provider (FSP 18147) based in Midstream Estate, Centurion, offering Discovery health, life, and short-term insurance, investment planning, and corporate insurance solutions.

listings.name: Crawdaddy's Montana
listings.current_description: Crawdaddy's Montana is a seafood and meat restaurant at Zambezi Junction Shopping Centre, part of the Crawdaddy's chain established in 1995, serving dishes that blend local, Mediterranean, Thai and Portuguese influences alongside gourmet burgers and grills.

listings.name: Create Beauty Skincare
listings.current_description: Create Beauty is an online skincare retailer based in Willow Park Manor, Pretoria, specialising in curated Korean skincare products including cleansers, toners, serums and sunscreens from brands such as COSRX, Anua, Axis-Y and Beauty of Joseon.

listings.name: Creative Avenue
listings.current_description: Creative Avenue is a design and marketing agency in Boardwalk Manor, Pretoria, offering logo and branding design, packaging, marketing materials, business stationery, digital design and rebranding services across industries including food and beverage, hospitality and retail.

listings.name: CreditSmart
listings.current_description: A financial services company specialising in debt review, credit counselling and debt consolidation, also offering credit score coaching, credit cover insurance and corporate solutions, registered with the FSCA (FSP 52295) and the National Credit Regulator (NCRDC3143).

listings.name: Crisp and Clean Pretoria North
listings.current_description: A branch of Crisp and Clean, a South African laundry and dry-cleaning service established in 2013, located in the Madelief Shopping Centre in Dorandia, offering wash and fold, dry cleaning, household items and commercial laundry services.

listings.name: Cudub Holdings (Pvt) Ltd
listings.current_description: Cudub Holdings is a Centurion-based solar energy company, founded in 2018, that designs and installs commercial and industrial photovoltaic systems as an approved PV GreenCard installer, managing projects from energy assessment through installation and utility interconnection.

listings.name: Cure Day Hospitals Erasmuskloof
listings.current_description: A same-day surgery hospital on Jochemus Street in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria, with 4 operating theatres and 30 beds, offering procedures in disciplines including ENT, general surgery, gynaecology, orthopaedics, ophthalmology, dermatology and dental surgery performed by specialist doctors.

listings.name: Curro Hazeldean high school
listings.current_description: An independent high school in Hazeldean, Pretoria, teaching Grades 8 to 12 under the CAPS curriculum with a project-based learning approach, instruction in English and Afrikaans, IEB matric exams, and class sizes capped at 25 learners.

listings.name: CV Master
listings.current_description: CV Master is an RMI-accredited automotive repair workshop in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, founded in 1979 and specialising in CV joints and driveshafts, alongside engine diagnostics, brakes, clutch and gearbox repair, auto electrical work and fleet maintenance.

listings.name: DAC Systems
listings.current_description: DAC Systems, established in 1995 and based in Lyttelton, Centurion, is a Microsoft Business Applications and Modern Work solutions partner providing advisory, implementation, licensing and managed services for Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Power Platform and Azure.

listings.name: DAFO South Africa
listings.current_description: DAFO South Africa, based in Derdepoort, supplies vehicle and equipment fire suppression systems, including cabinet and vehicle fire suppression, the Forrex extinguishing agent and linear heat detectors, serving the mining, construction, agriculture, transport and forestry sectors.

listings.name: Damp Seal SA in GAUTENG
listings.current_description: Damp Seal SA, founded in 1990, addresses rising damp and water-related structural problems through dampproofing, water drainage systems, roof treatment, crack repair, and interior/exterior painting, using permanent staff and offering 10-year guarantees on its work.

listings.name: DCK LIGHTING & ELECTRICAL
listings.current_description: DCK Lighting & Electrical is an electrical wholesaler based in Wierdapark, Centurion, supplying wiring accessories, cables, busbars, cable trays, safety equipment and testing instruments to residential and commercial clients, with a second branch in Mossel Bay.

listings.name: Development Trust of South Africa
listings.current_description: The Development Trust of South Africa (DTSA) is a self-sustaining asset management institution based in Salvokop, Pretoria, that works to grow public and private capital investment and advance sustainable economic development and opportunity in South Africa.

listings.name: Digital Hippo
listings.current_description: Digital Hippo is a digital marketing agency headquartered in Wonderboom South, Pretoria, offering Google Ads (PPC), SEO, social media marketing, web design, and content writing services, and advertises round-the-clock client support with a 30-day money-back guarantee.

listings.name: Digital Humanity - Web | Design | Mobile Apps | Digital Transformation | Planning
listings.current_description: Digital Humanity is a design and development agency based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, offering planning and strategy, UX/UI design, web and mobile development, and quality assurance services for clients ranging from startups to established enterprises.

listings.name: Digital Select Marketing
listings.current_description: Digital Select Marketing is a Pretoria digital marketing agency based in The Orchards, founded in 2015 by Given Jack, offering website design, SEO, Google Ads, social media marketing, e-commerce, and marketing consultation services to small businesses.

listings.name: Direct Debit
listings.current_description: Direct Debit is a PASA-registered first-tier payment collection bureau based in Waterkloof Glen, Pretoria, offering debit order collection via EFT and DebiCheck, recurring credit card payments, account verification, and billing software such as E-Mandate and SnapBill.

listings.name: Dischem Wonderboom Junction
listings.current_description: Dis-Chem is a major South African retail pharmacy chain offering medication, health and wellness products, beauty and baby care items, and in-store health clinic services; this branch serves the Wonderboom Junction area of Annlin West, Pretoria.

listings.name: DR C H Watson (EntreDyn)
listings.current_description: EntreDyn, based in Wonderboom, Pretoria, is a management consulting practice specializing in writing business plans, venture opportunity screening and management consultation for small and medium-sized businesses, including plans prepared for banks, investors and government funding institutions.

listings.name: Dream Supreme
listings.current_description: Dream Supreme Properties is a real estate agency based in Annlin, Pretoria, established in 2001, offering property buying and selling services, free consultations, and property valuations; it is part of the TeamWorxs Group Mandate Services network.

listings.name: Dunham-Bush Montana
listings.current_description: Dunham-Bush is the Montana Park branch of Dunham-Bush South Africa, a manufacturer founded in the USA in 1894 that supplies tailored HVAC/R (heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration) solutions for residential, commercial and industrial customers.
